description: Query an ArcGIS Feature Service / Map Service layer by its url (from search_datasets). SQL-like `where`, comma-separated `out_fields`, `order_by`, `limit`, `offset`. Returns attribute rows (and geometry). Use where="1=1" + out_fields="*" to sample.

out_fields.description: Comma-separated field names, or "*" for all (default).

url.description: Feature/Map Service layer url ending in /FeatureServer/<n> or /MapServer/<n>.

where.description: SQL where clause, e.g. "STATE = 'CA' AND YEAR >= 2020". Default "1=1".

name: query_layer
title: Query Layer
